on_screen_text: SACH BATAO KABHI KISI MEETING MEIN CHUP RAHE HO... SPEAKEASY APP PAR VANI AI... SIRF ₹1 RUPAYE KA TRIAL HAI... Install Now [Tell the truth, have you ever stayed silent in a meeting... On Speakeasy app, Vani AI... Trial is just ₹1... Install Now]
summary: The ad addresses the anxiety of staying silent in meetings due to English speaking difficulties. It promotes Speakeasy's Vani AI, which offers personalized practice, Hindi explanations, and instant corrections for 15 minutes a day, featuring a 1-rupee trial.
